# Frontend (search fixture)
## Loading [frontend]
- Show skeleton screens while content loads. (KB addition) {#fe.loading.skeletons}
- Lazy-load images below the fold. (KB addition) {#fe.loading.lazy-images}
- Serve images as AVIF or WebP with explicit width and height. (KB addition) {#fe.loading.image-formats}
## Bundles [frontend]
- Code-split per route so the first page ships less JavaScript. (KB addition) {#fe.bundles.code-split}
- Fail CI when the JavaScript bundle grows past its budget. (KB addition) {#fe.bundles.size-budget}
## Accessibility [frontend] [testing]
- Every interactive element is reachable by keyboard. (KB addition) {#fe.a11y.keyboard}
- Run an automated accessibility check (axe) in CI. (KB addition) {#fe.a11y.axe-ci}
